instruction.text: Find the image of summer on the diagram to learn more.

feedback.end: After spring, we get summer. Summer is June, July and August.

instruction.text: Find the clear sky to learn about the weather in the summer.

feedback.correct: The summer months are the warmest and driest of the year in the UK. During these months, it gets dark later, so we can play outside in the evenings.

instruction.text: Find the green leaves on the tree to learn more about plants in the summer.

text: Flowers are in full bloom during the summer, and the leaves are out on the trees. All of the flowers are perfect for insects, like bees and ladybirds.

instruction.text: Which of these things do you think you would see in summer? Drag the images to the correct groups.

hint.text: Select an image to hear a description.

feedback.finish: Great! Lots of people go on holiday in the summer as the weather is so nice. Beaches can get very busy - even in the UK!
